title: Penetration appeared without Swann ever discussing it beforehand

tellings.quote: penetration came right out of the clear blue never spoke a word of it

plain: Ingo Swann's 1998 book Penetration, in which Swann, a remote viewer (someone said to describe distant places by mind alone), wrote about strange secret encounters, came out of nowhere, according to a guest named Joe McMoneagle. McMoneagle, who knew Swann, tells Michels that it "came right out of the clear blue" and that Swann had "never spoke a word of it" before, which suggests Swann had kept the matter hidden even from people close to him.
